db_path="$temp_dir/tasks.json"

  echo '"'malformed database unexpectedly accepted'
  exit 1

  echo '"'missing malformed-database diagnostic'
  exit 1

  echo '"'malformed database was altered'
  exit 1
fi

if find "$temp_dir" -maxdepth 1 -name '"'.clean.json.*.tmp' -print -quit | rg -q .; then
  echo 'temporary atomic-write file remains'
  exit 1
fi
bun test"
